name: classes_with_text
note: class exports carrying a `ScriptText`

name: classes_with_block
note: of those, carrying a `/* ... */` block

name: comment_declarations
note: `function` declarations inside a block comment

name: comment_with_body
note: of those, with a brace-matched body in the same comment

name: comment_no_body
note: of those, a declaration without a body

name: live_declarations
note: `function` declarations in the same classes' live text -- the control's denominator

name: live_with_body
note: of those, whose body the same reader finds -- the extractor's rate

name: pairs
note: commented bodies whose name the live text also declares with a body

name: pairs_identical
note: of those, byte-identical to the live body

name: pairs_same_operators
note: of those, a different layout with the same operator multiset

name: pairs_differs
note: of those, moving at least one operator

name: pairs_live_stub
note: of those, whose live body is a trailer of 32 bytes or fewer

name: pairs_comment_bytes
note: bytes of the commented revisions of those pairs

name: pairs_live_bytes
note: bytes of their live revisions

name: pairs_comment_operators
note: operators in the commented revisions

name: pairs_live_operators
note: operators in the live revisions

name: disabled_bodies
note: commented bodies whose name no live body in the text carries

name: disabled_bytes
note: bytes of those bodies

name: disabled_operators
note: operators in those bodies

name: disabled_statements
note: statements at their own brace depth

name: disabled_stubs
note: of those, a trailer of 32 bytes or fewer
